name: fig4
description: Representative ER-1 numerical-stability diagnostic on MNIST, B=1024 (seed 0), with logarithmically sparse early-to-late step logging.

notes.logging: step 0 initialization/evaluation; diagnostics and evaluation at steps 1..9, 10,20,..,90, 100,200,..., and final.
notes.svd_diagnostics: FP32 matrix/SVD diagnostics at the same sparse optimization-step schedule as Fig.4 presentation.
notes.data: PROJECT/data; complete train/test tensors are preloaded to the target device once per run
notes.wall_clock: one synchronized timer from before step-0 evaluation through final evaluation; reported as total and total/optimization_steps
notes.dataset_revision: Revised from CIFAR10/B=4096 to MNIST/B=1024; max_steps remains 7500.
notes.evaluation: full train/test metrics at step 0, steps 1..9, 10..90 by 10, 100 onward by 100, and final.
notes.finite_check: no every-step host finite check; stable run is checked at endpoint while diagnostic steps retain SVD/layer materialization
notes.representative_run_revision: seed 0 x 3000 steps; Fig.4 diagnostic and evaluation logging use the sparse schedule 0, 1..9, 10..90 by 10, 100.. by 100.
